import core::option;
enum EvensResume { Next }
machine Evens on EvensResume -> core::option::Option<i32> {
    limit: i32,
    start Start;
    state Start {
        EvensResume::Next -> { let limit: i32 = self.limit; let i: i32 = 0;
    while (i < limit) {
        goto Yield0(i) with core::option::Some(i);
        i += 2;
    } goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    state Yield0(__lanius_gen_i: i32) {
        EvensResume::Next -> { let limit: i32 = self.limit; let i: i32 = __lanius_gen_i; { i += 2; } while (i < limit) {
        goto Yield0(i) with core::option::Some(i);
        i += 2;
    } goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    final state Done {
        EvensResume::Next -> stay with core::option::None(),
    }
}
fn evens(limit: i32) -> Evens { return evens_start(limit); }
impl Evens {
    fn next(&mut self) -> core::option::Option<i32> { return self.step(EvensResume::Next); }
}
